title: Windowed reservoir sampler and late-arrival correction for token metering heatmap
creator: Ava Kim
description:
Problem:
Our downstream cost-attribution dashboards and per-customer billing summaries depend on a time-windowed aggregation of token events. We see two recurring issues: (1) hotspots in the per-minute heatmaps that are unstable because we sample naively and (2) skewed billed usage when out-of-order or late-arriving token events are dropped by upstream windowing logic. Both cause noisy alerts for customers and require manual reconciliation jobs that run daily.

Goal:
Implement a windowed reservoir sampler + deterministic late-arrival correction layer in the metering pipeline so that: (a) heatmap visualizations are stable across small gaps in event arrival and representative of true token distribution; (b) billing attribution remains accurate within the SLA window and reduces manual adjustments by >90%; (c) sampling overhead and storage cost are bounded.

Proposed design summary:
- Ingest: token events flow through Kafka topic token-events-v2 (partitioned by customer_id).
- Pre-aggregation stream (Flink): maintain fixed-length sliding windows (1m, 1h) per routing key. For heatmaps we attach a bounded reservoir sampler (size tuned per-customer-tier) that stores representative token samples instead of full token lists. Reservoirs are deterministic using a hash-based RNG seeded by (customer_id, window_start) to allow idempotent recompute on retries.
- Late-arrival correction: maintain a small correction log in ClickHouse per window with aggregate deltas and a flag for windows that are marked `mutable` for N minutes (configurable, default 5m). When late events arrive, we reconcile using the correction log and a deterministic merge that updates sampled reservoirs using weighted replacement rather than naive append.
- Output: write stable sample summaries and corrected aggregates to the billing-aggregates table and heatmap-samples table. Emit reconciliation events to a low-latency topic billing-reconciliations for downstream consumers (console, billing engine).

Acceptance criteria:
- Heatmap aggregator shows <5% variance in top-10 hotspot tiles between adjacent runs for the same time window (vs ~18% baseline).
- Reconciliation lag for late-arriving events handled by this job is <30s on p95 during normal load, <3m during 95th percentile bursts.
- Nightly manual reconciliation tasks for customers using this dataset reduced by at least 90% for sampled customers in the pilot cohort.
- CPU/memory overhead for active reservoirs remains below 25% of current pre-aggregation cluster baseline.

Rollout plan:
1) Implement sampler + correction in a feature-flagged Flink job and run in shadow mode for a month against a 10% pilot (internal + opt-in customers).
2) Validate metrics (variance, latency) and iterate sampling sizes per tier.
3) Gradually promote to production for the remainder of the fleet, enabling write-path once thresholds are met.

Observability & failure modes:
- Expose reservoir fill ratios, replacement rate, correction log sizes, and reconciliation success/failure counts to console (per-tenant).
- Fallback: if sampler module fails, job falls back to lightweight count-only aggregation and emits a high-severity alert; no writes to billing-aggregates until manual unfreeze.
comments: 2026-02-16 - Initial design review: PM (Marco Ruiz) asked to ensure determinism for idempotent recompute; added hash-seed approach.
2026-02-20 - Engineering sync: decided on Flink (stateful sliding windows) over Beam due to existing infra and operator expertise. Rahul volunteered to prototype reservoir logic.
2026-02-28 - Prototype results: reservoir size 256 per high-tier customer gave stable heatmap results; memory footprint under threshold on canary cluster.

2026-03-03 - Security review note: reviewed with Security (Priya Nair); confirmed no plaintext PII is retained by sampler. KMS not needed for sampler state; access controls applied to ClickHouse tables.
2026-03-08 - PR feedback: data-platform reviewer (J. Ortega) requested an integration test that replays out-of-order events and asserts deterministic reservoir state; added tests to pipeline repo.
2026-03-10 - Pilot toggle added to infra config; triggering shadow runs for 10% of customers starting 2026-03-11. Monitoring dashboards created under `console/analytics/heatmap-reservoir`.
